title: Cat Crisis
description:
Cat Crisis is an online co-op game about being cute little cats rescuing even cuter kittens. Hide from terrifying dogs, pet frightened kittens, and rescue them to save all catkind!

BECOME A CATSometimes you’ll need to be quiet, sneaking under furniture, and avoid the monsters. Sometimes you’ll need to throw bombs, set off traps, or press the "meow" button as fast as you can. 

PET KITTENSFind helpless kittens and pet them gently to keep them calm. If you pet them too hard (or smack them, you monster), they'll panic and jump out of your arms.

KEEP THE RUN GOINGCat Crisis is a roguelike where you get stronger and the level gets harder every mission. Break vases and rescue kittens to earn cash, then spend the cash to buy crossbows, grenades, time bubbles and more! Rescue more and more kittens until you die trying - then do it all over again!

TEAM UPSaving all cat-kind takes a team of fearless feline warriors. Play Cat Crisis with up to 4 players!
